detail.longDescription:
Explore the world with maps, live views, and powerful location tools.
GeoScope combines a GPS camera, interactive maps, and global exploration features into one easy-to-use app. Discover places, capture moments, and navigate with confidence wherever you go.
Features
• Explore public live views from locations around the world
• Browse street views and discover places from past to present
• Capture photos with GPS location, map tags, and timestamps
• Navigate the world with an interactive 3D Earth
• Discover famous landmarks and popular destinations
• Check traffic conditions with real-time map information
• Use the built-in compass for everyday navigation
Whether you're exploring new places, saving travel memories, or learning about locations around the world, GeoScope provides useful tools in one simple experience.
Discover more. Explore further.
